commits.subject: wm: observe durable service-failed retry child in coordinate-queued-retry

repair.mechanism: coordinate-queued-retry (src/futon2/aif/meta_repair_coordinator.clj) gains an optional read-only :retry-click-status-fn port. When the ledger has no pending-requeue observation for the enacted retry-click, the port is consulted; a durably :failed child with outcome :service-failed and a valid evidence pin appends the same :retry-inconclusive observation terminal ingestion would have appended (ledger/append-observation with attribution {injury-id, retry-click}), then the existing requeue loop runs unchanged: next requeue id minted via retry-click-id, or the typed :abandoned/:retry-budget-spent terminal when the budget is spent.
repair.evidence_preservation: The observation's record-pin seals the child's own durable futon3c acceptance bytes (wm/click-state-v1), which retain the actual failure: outcome :service-failed, error message 'Serving runner source drifts from the canonical checkout', attempt-id nil, completed-at. No typed data is invented; the legacy child's message-only shape flows through as-is.
fabrication_guards: Only {:status :failed} + result outcome :service-failed is a failure; running/queued/completed/not-found/nil are not observed (tested: running-or-completed-child-is-never-observed).

A :failed report without a valid 64-hex evidence pin refuses :coordinator/failed-child-evidence-refused rather than appending an unsourced observation (tested: failed-child-without-evidence-pin-refuses-typedly).

Duplicate prevention: an already-ingested evidence pin is never observed twice, so crash-repair replays and ordinary replays are idempotent (tested: failed-child-observation-is-not-duplicated covers both a pre-appended crash state and a full replay).
repair.budget_honesty: No budget change. append-requeue still abandons at (>= requeues retry-limit) without an other-open-injury explanation; tested in failed-child-observation-respects-spent-retry-budget-honestly, which ends :abandoned/:retry-budget-spent with zero retry-port calls. NOTE for Joe/codex-11: the live ledger entry 50 carries :requeues 3 = :retry-limit 3 with no other open injury currently explaining the child, so the honest expected terminal for THIS chain after the repair is :abandoned/:retry-budget-spent, not another requeue — unless a qualifying other open injury exists at resume time.
repair.wiring: meta_self_heal_production.clj effect-ports forwards :retry-click-status-fn from opts when it is a function; absence is not a defect (the starved-awaiting behavior is preserved). The futon3c side should supply the port backed by runner_service click-status / the acceptance EDN (pin = sha256 of that file's bytes); that wiring is deliberately left to the serving side.
